values: Definitions, compatibility boundaries, and source-of-truth notes for WebCTRL mapping.
28 equipment groups / 318 BACnet objects. Controlled restart and VAV point-exposure acceptance completed 2026-07-23.
Simulator publishes the value; WebCTRL reads or subscribes.
WebCTRL/EIKON commands the point through the BACnet priority array.
The object accepts BACnet WriteProperty and supports priority/release behavior.
Hard safety input checked before normal commands; highlighted red in Point List.
Equipment group instance_offset + the point's local object_instance.
AV:81 heating minimum, AV:82 heating maximum, AV:83 cooling minimum, AV:84 cooling maximum; all read-only CFM values.
AV:85 publishes the simulated effective position after actuator faults. It is separate from writable AO:20 damper command.
All 233 previously live object identifiers are unchanged. Only the 85 new AV objects require WebCTRL discovery/mapping.
External physical ZS thermostats; the simulator does not publish those temperatures.
Zone Humidity AI:3; published globally as AI:13003 through AI:25003.
Not published, by request. These virtual zones publish temperature only.
config/supervisory_device.json and config/devices/*.json. Regenerate after any object-model change.
